featured_reviews.review_text: Pathetic experience, think 10 times before booking them. featured_reviews.name: Khushbu Gaisota
featured_reviews.review_text:
There were lot of hic ups, we asked for less intense smoke bubbles which was not followed. The rose petal shower was not happening over us but next to us, we had a runner and a host basically both were useless both didn’t inform he flower guy to come ahead to make petals fall on us properly. We customised the sunboard ourselves and made sure it reached them before hand but it was missing until we mentioned it to them to keep it, it had no flower arrangements around which were pre discussed.
The dj, runner and host were useless please avoid booking them with these guys. The dj played randomly “chote chote bhaiyo k badey bhaiya” on grooms entry without confirming with anyone, host said 2 lines during varmala and then she was no where to be seen utterly useless. The runner didn’t manage a single hic up or even noticed of it was happening. The wife of decorator was chasing us for the balance 20% throughout when our wedding was happening, instead of of putting in the energy to make the smallest of details right.
We had respected the quotation and didn’t push on any unrealistic negotiation.
We even paid everything on time, even though they were chasing us during the entire event, not realising or managing the goof ups that were happening in the background.
The things that were ruined for us was very miss managed and disappointing.
Additionally, the things that were discussed regarding the decor before hand were changed last minute without any prior intimation.
I am disappointed to have experienced all this as we had such good conversations with them at the beginning and went ahead with so much confidence. I think these things are important and shouldn’t be taken lightly before booking your decorator

They claimed that their prices are high because they offer quality and take responsibility. 10% things we took from them were the lowest point in the wedding (basic from handkerchiefs). After telling them about it, they didn’t had the professionalism to acknowledge it.

Event management, shadows were good but no coordination with events, artists etc. our family spent most of the time managing the event team and didn’t enjoy the function.

They spoke a lot but didn’t deliver 1%. Super disappointed and not recommended

The handled lights and sound which was good in few events and didn’t exist in others (including wedding).

Not recommended

featured_reviews.name: Ronak Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text: We had the absolute pleasure of working with Hitch Key Weddings and I can't recommend them enough. From the very beginning, Aayushi Modi and her team were professional, visionary, and incredibly detail-oriented. Their creativity truly sets them apart. Each event had a distinct theme and energy, yet flowed beautifully into the next.

featured_reviews.name: SHRADDHA SRIVASTAVA
featured_reviews.review_text: Working with Aayushi was a beautiful experience. The event planners can truly make your wedding memorable and magical and Aayushi certainly made it happen. With her she’s always ready to make your ideas and thoughts come alive by her creativity. The best part about them is they have solutions for things you don’t even expect and there’s never a No for anything you demand.

featured_reviews.name: chandan bhakuni
featured_reviews.review_text: Working with Hitchkey was an unforgettable experience. I knew after our first meeting that only Aayushi would be going ahead with the wedding. I called them during all of my bridezilla phases, they were only a phone call away. Everything from the decor to the handling of guests at the venue, logistics to hotel check-ins was perfect.

featured_reviews.name: Saroj Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Management was really very poor. Right from the room check ins to check outs every thing was delayed and was in chaos (Proper planning and execution is really required). Almost missed my flight due to their lack of communication and prompt action.

Just one advice to anyone who wants to hire them; do get a guarantee from them to be held liable for any losses you may suffer whether financially or healthwise, since I suffered both.

featured_reviews.name: Ashok Natani
featured_reviews.review_text: Hitchkey team truly bring your vision to life. I felt calm and at peace with Aayushi around. She is great to work with and the entire team is extremely patient and understanding. I highly recommend them for your dream to come true. - Prachi Bansal- Bride
